meta_data.base_class: Find transfer <public transportation> routes connecting departure, transfer, and destination cities - refers to reservable public transport options that support transfers.

tool_template.name: find_transfer_<class>_routes
tool_template.description: Find transfer <class> routes from an origin city to a destination city with a stopover in a transfer city.

origin_city.description: The starting city for the <class> route.

transfer_city.description: The city where the transfer takes place for the <class> route.

destination_city.description: The final destination city for the <class> route.

departure_time.description: Preferred departure time for the <class> route in ISO 8601 format.

ticket_class.description: Class of service for the <class> route, one of: 'economy', 'business', and 'first'.

maximum_duration.description: Maximum acceptable duration in hours for the entire <class> route journey.

number_of_passengers.description: Acceptable total number of passengers for the <class> route.

luggage_allowance.description: The maximum luggage allowance in kilograms required for the <class> route.
